Of the 63 round-3 issues I class 58 as RESOLVED, 2 as PARTLY (both minor documentation points: the list of outside files the engines need, and the path mapping in CHECKPOINT.md), 0 as NOT RESOLVED and 3 as NOT APPLICABLE (records that said "no problem").
